title: Forge Line
description: Lane defense on the asteroid belt — deploy mining rigs, hold the scrap golems, protect the Core Reactor.
detailedDescription: Helios Belt Mining Co. needs you on the night shift. Place automated rigs on a 5×9 conveyor grid, harvest Steam from ore collectors, and stop rusted scrap golems before they reach your reactor. Whimsical industrial tone with Foreman Greg, 24 campaign levels across four worlds, endless survival, and cloud saves.
controls: Click seed tray to select rig · Click grid to place · Shovel to salvage · Space to pause

achievements.title: OSHA Miracle
achievements.description: Win a level without reactor damage
